annotations.title: Remove a product from a cart

description: Removes a product from an anonymous Trailhead Supply cart and returns the whole cart. Removing a product the cart does not hold leaves the cart as it is.

cart_token.description: The cart_token an earlier cart answer returned.

locale.description: Answer language: en (default en). Names, labels and URLs follow it.

product.description: The product: its public_id from an earlier answer, its page URL or slug on the store's website, or the manufacturer model number.

name: cart_remove_item

answer_type.description: What this answer is, for rendering.

cart_token.description: Pass it to the other cart tools. A secret: whoever holds it can change this cart.

cart_url.description: Opens the store's website with these products in the shopper's own cart, where they review and order; nothing is ordered before that.

delivery_hint.description: How delivery is charged, in the answer language.

discount_total.description: The bundle saving; 0 without a whole bundle.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601; every change pushes it back.

branches.description: The stores or warehouses holding it, each with its state. Empty when the store does not say.

label.description: The stock line the store's website shows, in the answer language.

badges.description: For example new, sale or featured.

kit.description: The bundle this line belongs to; null for a plain line.

complete.description: False: a line left the bundle, so its discount no longer applies.

saving.description: This line's share of the bundle saving.

line_total.description: Sale prices applied, before the bundle saving.

amount.description: The price a visitor pays, in the card's currency; null when on request or not on sale.

compare_at.description: The higher crossed-out price of a sale.

on_request.description: True: the price is given on request (call or message the store).

public_id.description: Pass it to get_product or compare_products.

url.description: The product page on the store's website, in the answer language; cite it.

subtotal.description: Before delivery and the bundle saving.

total.description: What the cart costs before delivery, discounts taken off; the store's website shows the same.

truncated.description: Present and true only when the answer outgrew the size budget and its last list items were left out; ask narrower to see them.

title: Remove a product from a cart
